name: Review
description: A customer's words on a card over your photo, with their stars and name. For a review, a testimonial or a thank-you.

rating.label: Stars
rating.description: The stars they gave, 1 to 5. 0 shows none.

quote.label: Their words
quote.description: What they said, without quotation marks: the card adds them.

name.label: Name
name.description: Who said it, e.g. Sarah M.

detail.label: About them
detail.description: A line about them, e.g. Customer since 2021. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: Your account handle, top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

photo.label: Photo
photo.description: The photo behind the words: a person, a place or a product, with no words in it. Upload one, pick one from the Library, or let AI make one. Without it, your brand colours show.

sample_data.quote: Best haircut I've had in years. Friendly, on time, and they actually listened.
sample_data.name: Sarah M.
